This folder is populated automatically when you build the solution in Release:

  dotnet build TNTradePanel.slnx -c Release

Layout (mirrors Quantower Settings\Scripts):

  plug-ins/TNTradePanel/          → C:\Quantower\Settings\Scripts\plug-ins\TNTradePanel\
  Indicators/TNTradePanelLines/   → C:\Quantower\Settings\Scripts\Indicators\TNTradePanelLines\

Commit the updated files here when you publish a new version to GitHub.
End users: see the main README.md → Install.
